note: Improved MDC campground on the east side of the 158-acre lake off Route KK, with 84 numbered sites in three loops; loop A sits on a wooded lakeshore point near the boat ramp and dock. Camping only at the numbered sites; the horse camp on the west side is for equestrian riders only. --Claude
summary: Changed: pin was on the equestrian-only horse camp (GIS 304, west side) - move 1.2 km to the main campground (loops A/B/C, 84 numbered sites, gravel pads) on the east side. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights manual + 2027 permit; sites 84 and privies added. Not waterfront kept (loop A pads 25-40 m from the lake behind a continuous wooded bank). Phone matches.
flags: PIN (important): stored 40.01489,-91.98538 = GIS 304 at the west-side lot off Route E, which the map shows with a privy + camping symbol and the brochure makes the horse camp: 'Camping for equestrian riders is not allowed at campsites 1-84. Horseback riders may load, unload and camp at horse camp on the west side of lake.' 'Camping at horse camp is for equestrian riders only.' Move the pin to Campground A, 40.0093,-91.9740 (GIS 193 at 40.00940,-91.97360 is on the loop's east end), ~1.2 km SE. No split: the horse camp is equestrian-only (out of scope); loops B and C (GIS 191/192, ~500 m S of A) share the same entrance road off KK.

INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'It also has an improved campground with gravel pads, fire grates, and privies'; Things to Do 'Camping: Individual Campsites'; brochure 'Camping is permitted only at numbered sites in the designated campground.' Map: Campground A 1-22, B 23-50, C 51-84. Imagery: loop A gravel back-in/pull-in pads ~15-20 m on a gravel loop - a 23-ft rig fits. Stored note's '4 camping spots' was the GIS count, not the site count.

WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): loop A pads are 25-40 m from the lake but behind a continuous wooded bank (leaf-on imagery: unbroken tree line along the whole point), no open apron; B and C are 150 m+ back in forest. A filtered lakeview from some A sites is possible but not confirmable from imagery - left down.

FEES FROM MARCH 2027 (applies to every MDC area entry and the state:missouri-conservation-areas policy row): MDC release https://mdc.mo.gov/node/307038 ('Campers will need permits to camp on MDC areas starting in March'): 'The Missouri Conservation Commission gave final approval at its Oct. 23 open meeting ... to regulation changes ... that would require campers to purchase a permit to camp on MDC areas starting in March 2027'; 'purchase a permit for $5 for up to five days of camping on conservation areas for up to 10 people'; 'Each person will be limited to three consecutive camping permits and six camping permits annually'; 'available for purchase beginning in March online, at a permit vendor, or over the phone'. The camping page still says 'All camping on conservation areas is free' (true until then), so nightly_low/high 0 written as today's value with the 2027 permit in fees.note; the policy row's fees and booking note need the same update.

Note rewritten: acreage, generic MDC text, the GIS '4 spots', 14-day limit (now booking.max_stay_nights), 'site length not published' and directions dropped; the campground loops and the horse-camp restriction put in.
